For any derivative steel article that is classified in one of the subheadings of the HTSUS that is listed in this subdivision, the
additional ad valorem duty imposed by heading 9903.81.91 shall only apply to the declared value of the steel content of the
derivative article. The quantity of the steel content shall be reported in kg for heading 9903.81.91, in addition to the units
provided in chapters 1 through 97 for the derivative steel article, in accordance with Statistical Note 1(b) of Chapter 99.
